summary: Jaraad Kamal graduated from the University of Maryland College Park with a degree in Computer Science in May 2023 with a GPA of 4.0.

He is an impact-driven software engineer with strong expertise in systems design. Has expertise in full stack development, cloud-based CI/CD (AWS, GCP, GitHub Actions), delivering scalable solutions to SaaS, enterprise, and AI/ML systems. Known for solving complex and technical challenges, optimizing solutions, and collaborating with teams. Experience with designing end to end full stack solutions, incorporating Large Language Models (LLMs), handling sensitive data through SQL or NoSQL systems.

In his spare time, he works on video game development and other programming projects. Most video game development is through C# and the unity framework. His other programming skills include C/C++ Ruby, Golang, Rust, Lisp.
